overview_description.description:
Entropik is the global leader in Emotion AI, powering a Unified Human Insights Platform. Our platform turns human emotions into business intelligence so brands can understand and connect with customers in more meaningful ways.

Business Impact:
Our unified platform delivers insights in days, not weeks. Teams launch faster, optimize campaigns with confidence, and turn research from a cost center into a competitive advantage.

about_short_description.short_description: Entropik's Decode AI platform turns emotions and behavior into business insights, enabling brands to connect deeply with customers.

product.name: Decode
product.description: An integrated consumer research platform using AI to gather quantitative, qualitative, media, diary, and shopper insights for understanding consumer behavior and preferences.

product.name: Qatalyst
product.description: An integrated user research platform with AI capabilities for moderated and unmoderated research, live web/app testing, and user feedback analysis.

product.name: Facial Coding Technology
product.description: A technology that captures and quantifies human emotions by analyzing facial expressions using webcams or smartphone cameras.

product.name: Behavior AI
product.description: A technology that analyzes user attention, engagement, and interaction preferences by tracking eye movements and mouse activity.

product.name: Insights AI
product.description: A suite of AI technologies including Emotion AI, Behavior AI, Generative AI, and Predictive AI to analyze human insights, consumer preferences, and forecast trends.
